name: Cheesy Beef & Hash Brown Patties with Ranch Mixed Green Salad
ingredients: 2 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes
instructions: Place hash browns in a colander; rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the hash browns as you can.
Place hash browns in a medium bowl along with beef, cheese, eggs, salt, and pepper. Mix with your hands to combine, then form into 12 equal-sized patties and place on a plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the tomatoes, along with dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad and patties between plates. Drizzle patties with ketchup and enjoy!
author: Mealime
